orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Mk1, a hull mount (outward is up): twin bells outside, an armoured wall collar, and inside a core with lamp panel and bars, a hatch with one turbine, feed pipes, a repair hatch, a green-ringed power coupling and a glowing vent grille. Damaged: the left bell lip is dented in and hanging, the right bell cracked and sputtering, the collar scorched, the turbine stalls, hatch cracked and sparking, lamps red. Disabled: the left nozzle snapped off at the neck, the right bent over, manifold snapped, wall collar cracked, the core dead with its repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
